_comment: Mursit (Turkish ModernBERT) stage 1: models/Mursit-Base-4k (context extension, built by scripts/download_models.py --mursit-4k) with native tokenization + BOS + mean pooling; boundary head config AND weights warm-started from gliner2.5-multi-v1 (136/136 tensors).
